# OIML Certificate NMi **OIML Member State** The Netherlands Number R60/2017-A-NL1-21.23 Project number 2602161 Page 1 of 2 Issuing authority NMi Certin B.V. Person responsible: M.Ph.D. Schmidt Applicant and Manufacturer Cardinal Scale Manufacturing Company 102 East Daugherty Street Webb City, MO 64807 United States of America Identification of the certified type A **shear beam load cell**, with strain gauges. Type                                    :   HSB, HAB and TB Characteristics See next page This OIML Certificate is issued under scheme A. 2629 JA Delft
The Netherlands
